svg.title: KarWed
svg.desc: KarWed: Real-time photo and message sharing for weddings and events. What it does: Guests scan a QR code and upload photos and messages, with no app to download. Uploads appear on the venue’s big screen as a live slideshow through SignalR. Admin moderation approves or rejects content in seconds. White-label B2B mode lets venues use their own logo, name and theme colour. Free, Plus, Pro and Salon Business subscription tiers, with Google sign-in. Built with: C#, .NET 8, ASP.NET Core MVC, SignalR, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server, ASP.NET Core Identity, Google OAuth, ImageSharp, Razor, JavaScript.
